part: LM317LZ (U-REG-DAC) - ST LM217L/LM317L datasheet (the LCSC-stocked LM317LZ, C5267874)
notes: ST DocID2168 Rev 7, September 2015, 23 pp, 'LM217L, LM317L Low current 1.2 to 37 V adjustable voltage regulators'. Linked from LCSC C5267874 (ST LM317LZ, TO-92). Table 5 p.7 (LM317L, TJ 0-125C, VI-VO 5 V, IO 40 mA): IO(min) minimum load current 3.5 typ / 5 MAX mA at VI-VO = 40 V (TI: 1.5 / 2.5); VREF 1.2 / 1.25 / 1.3 V; IADJ 50 / 100 uA; line reg 0.01 / 0.04 %/V at 25C; SVR 65 dB (CADJ=0), 66 min / 80 typ with CADJ = 10 uF; IO(max) 100 typ / 200 mA.
